newsitem.title: UK: Lower prices fail to tempt UK feed market buyers.
newsitem.headline: Lower prices fail to tempt UK feed market buyers.

text.p: Easier soymeal prices on the UK meals and feeds market failed to attract buyers on Tuesday.
"Buyers have got 190 stg in their sights and they will not move until they get it," said a trader.
However, traders said the 190-stg level is unlikely to be hit following the bounce on the Chicago futures at the opening.
High protein soymeal offers were around two to three stg down with ex-mill sellers for Nov at around 195 stg.
